# `an_unpaid_invoice_beside_its_deposit_unapplied.txt` with Acme's deposit put
# in a credit lot of Acme's by `lot_owner:`: in a lot, and one that settles no
# invoice. Load after `payment_roundtrip_accounts.txt`.
customer "C001"
	name: "Acme"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-001"
	customer_id: "C001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "Service"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-01
		due: 2026-01-31
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-001"
		accumulate: true

2026-01-15 * "Supplies paid"
	Assets:Bank -100.00 CAD
		memo: "Payment INV-001"
	Expenses:Supplies 100.00 CAD

	Assets:Bank 100.00 CAD
		memo: "Payment INV-001"
